events.text: New Year's Eve: the reunion dinner, with fish that must never be finished, so there is always plenty.

effects.log: Plenty for the year ahead.
Laughter until midnight.

events.text: Red envelopes are handed out to the young and unmarried.

effects.log: A row of bowing children. (−5 taels)
Luck, wrapped in red. (+3 taels)

events.text: At midnight, the whole city explodes with firecrackers.

effects.log: The loudest luck in the street.

choices.text: Hold a scared dog through it

effects.log: The dog trusts you forever.

events.text: On the first day, everyone visits elders and teachers to pay respects.

effects.log: Old masters, glad to see you.
An awkward bow. Something thaws.

events.text: Tradition says: no sweeping on the first day, or you sweep away your luck.

effects.log: Crumbs everywhere. Luck everywhere.
The neighbours are horrified.

events.text: A young fighter challenges you on New Year's Day, which is terribly bad manners.

effects.log: The crowd approves. The youngster is embarrassed.

ok.log: One move, and he is sitting in the snow. Happy new year.

fail.log: He wins. Bad luck all year, the crowd mutters.

events.text: The new year temple fair: acrobats, opera, candy men, and crowds.

effects.log: A girl balances on a pole on a man on a horse.
You ring the bell. A prize: a clay tiger.

events.text: In the crowd, you feel a hand in your purse.

ok.log: A small boy. You give him a coin and a warning.

fail.log: Gone. So is some silver. (−4 taels)

choices.text: Keep your purse inside your robe

effects.log: Crowds teach caution.

events.text: New Year! New clothes, red envelopes, and staying up until midnight.

effects.log: The loudest, brightest night of your life.
You are rich. Briefly.

events.text: A mountain temple where people climb at dawn on New Year's Day to ring the great bell.

effects.log: The sound rolls across the valley. A good start.

choices.text: Help old people up the steps

effects.log: A hundred steps, a dozen grateful grandparents.

events.text: At the temple, people write wishes for the year on red paper.

effects.log: The ink dries. The wish stays.

choices.text: Wish for the people you love

effects.log: A better wish.

events.text: A relative you quarrelled with sends a new year gift.

effects.log: The quarrel ends quietly.
Tears and laughter. Family is complicated.
